ns0:svg.ns0:title: Support controls the direction of KL convergence
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: pε=(1−ε,ε), δ=(1,0); 0<ε≤0.1. Endpoint ε=0 has both KL values zero. TV(pε,δ)=ε; KL(δ||pε)=−log(1−ε); KL(pε||δ)=+∞ for every ε>0. Native extended-real KL; null means +∞, never a plotted finite replacement. TV convergence does not imply KL convergence in both directions.
